text: dsh-market-desktop 是面向 DSH Desktop 的可视化插件市场，在设置页提供发现、主题和已安装插件界面。它通过 DSH 的 Web 设置区和本地 HTTP 路由读取目录及配置文件，并调用插件运行时完成安装管理。用户可以搜索分类、查看安装状态、安装或更新插件、切换主题，并导入导出配置备份；界面还提供诊断、日志和插件分组。适合希望在桌面端集中发现和维护 DSH 插件的用户。使用时需要本机 pnpm；在线目录不可用时会读取随包附带的目录快照。

dsh-market-desktop is a visual plugin market in DSH Desktop Settings. Search the catalog, install or update plugins, switch themes, and back up or restore profile settings from one page. It uses local routes and pnpm, with a bundled catalog snapshot as an offline fallback.

dsh-market-desktop 的功能「浏览插件目录」：在设置页查看插件目录，并按关键词和分类筛选条目。搜索输入在发现页触发筛选，目录由在线注册表或随包快照提供。
dsh-market-desktop 的功能「安装插件」：从目录条目发起安装，页面显示操作状态与结果；服务端路由执行包管理并返回安装状态。
dsh-market-desktop 的功能「管理已安装插件」：查看已安装项目和激活状态，并可触发更新或卸载。操作由已安装列表及更新、卸载路由完成。
dsh-market-desktop 的功能「切换主题」：在主题页选择已安装主题，切换时停用其他主题并保存当前选择，供后续启动恢复。
dsh-market-desktop 的功能「配置备份与恢复」：通过备份界面导出配置，或提交备份文件进行恢复；路由提供本地备份下载和恢复操作。

dshmarket README · dsh-market-desktop：The plugin market for [DSH Desktop](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop) (the Electron desktop app of DeepSeek Harness). Forked from [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) (MIT License).

dshmarket README · Changes vs upstream：- **Desktop compatibility**: peer/dev dependencies pinned from `^0.1.0-rc.7` down to `^0.1.0-rc.6`, matching the dsh version bundled with DSH Desktop, so the market shows up in Desktop's settings page.
- **Install fix**: fixes `ERR_PNPM_LINKED_PKG_DIR_NOT_FOUND` (`not install from ... as it does not exist`) when installing any plugin — if the profile has a stale `file:node_modules/<pkg>` dependency, the market now rewrites it to `link:../node_modules/<pkg>` and retries automatically.

dshmarket README · Option 1: install straight from this repo (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:KokuYu-sysu/dsh-market-desktop
```

dshmarket README · About npm：`dsh plugin add dshmarket` installs the **upstream** `dshmarket` package from npm (rc.7 deps), **not this fork**.
To offer an npm install, publish this fork under a new package name (e.g. `dsh-market-desktop`).

dshmarket README · Usage：1. Start DSH Desktop.
2. Open **Settings → Plugin Market**.
3. Browse / search and click **Install**.

> The first install needs pnpm; the market prompts at the top and offers one-click setup.

dshmarket README · `not install from ... as it does not exist`：The profile has a stale local dependency. This version auto-repairs it; if it still fails, check the `file:` / `link:` entries in `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json`.
section: `not install from ... as it does not exist`

text: dshmarket README · "build scripts" authorization prompt：pnpm ≥10 blocks dependency build scripts by default (usually when installing other plugins that need a build step). Click "Allow build scripts and retry" in the market.
